children: rose 1.27% premarket after Berenberg upgraded it to Buy from Hold and lifted its price target to $1,400 from $1,220, implying roughly 22% upside from current levels. The firm's 2026 return on research investment work found Lilly delivering best-in-class returns, and it expects the company to hold its lead in obesity.

Berenberg puts Lilly at roughly $60 billion year to date across more than 25 business development transactions, with capacity to spend more. It argues many of the resulting pipeline additions carry multibillion-dollar sales potential and offer diversification that investors are underestimating.

Zepbound and Mounjaro are established leaders in obesity and diabetes. Berenberg expects the imminent diabetes approval for Foundayo, the oral GLP-1, to unlock significant demand after a slow start, and says the Medicare Bridge program is driving a steep uptick in demand for Lilly's obesity drugs. It sees upside to fiscal 2026 guidance.

title: Berenberg Lifts Lilly to Buy With a $1,400 Target
